metadata.availability: Accepted native extraction with audited coupled missing B/EE completion; GE, TE and With Egestion WARN. All 250 catch labels reviewed with provisional membership/allocation assumptions; extreme TE dependence and source/runtime limitations are documented in the regional report.
metadata.coverage_note: Falkland shelf at depths up to 300 m; reported study area approximately 200000 km², target geodesic area 1170515.946 km². If nearly all reported study area lies within the target, A is approximately 17.09% and B approximately 100%. These are conditional reported-area/subarea estimates, not a measured polygon intersection or independently verified containment. The source figures do not define a recoverable model shelf contour. The inherited rectangle is removed from the live article display; source figures, historical footprint and target boundary remain retained.

metadata.selection_rationale: User selected PAT2024_FalklandShelf_2020_native because the native-source reconstruction did not FAIL. GE, TE and With Egestion all return WARN, not OK. Computational input uses the audited coupled Ecopath solution only for source-missing living/producer B and EE; source model.json and the native database remain unchanged. Native discard routing and loader-derived detritus accumulation limitations remain explicit; Falkland shelf is a subregion of the LME.
